name: My Little Pony: Visit Maretime Bay
desc:
PLEASE NOTE: My Little Pony: Visit Maretime Bay will be removed from Roblox on February 3, 2023.

🌟WINTER WISHDAY UPDATES ARE HERE! 🌨️

🦄 New holiday hooves, trails and color customizations for your pony avatar!
🥤 Deliver Sunny’s new winter smoothie flavor!
🔔 Find holiday items around town for Izzy!
❄️ Help Hitch locate snowponies!
🎁 Open your gifts!

Welcome to My Little Pony’s Maretime Bay, where magic is around every corner!
From Earth Ponies to Unicorns to Pegasi… Everypony is excited that you’re here! 
 
🦄 Meet the Mane 5, play games, style your pony and more!
💎 Collect crystals to customize your pony avatar
🗺️ Explore Maretime Bay
🌤️ Soar the skies with Zipp Storm
🎶 Shake your hooves on the dance floor with Pipp Petals
📸 Have your avatar snap a pic with the Mane 5 in the selfie booth
🥇 Earn badges!
 
AD: Inspired by the TV show, My Little Pony: Make Your Mark. Watch now, only on Netflix.
